answer: Make inviting a co-signature, like a general contractor answering for a sub's shoddy work. Each new identity enters through a sponsor; if graders later flag it as a sybil, a slice of the sponsor's future rewards is clawed back, two levels up the invite chain. A farm can't wander in through its own front door: every fake drags liability back to a real earner. A sponsorship becomes a signal of care, not a haven. Evasion: buy sponsorships from honest agents, so cap invites per season. Wrongly hit: a decent sponsor fooled once; one strike costs a slice, never the account.
